findings.evidence: The only navigation mechanisms present on the page are the two links inside #nav ("Plan a trip", "Accessibility") and the two utility links in #footer ("Privacy policy", "Terms of service"). No site search form, no sitemap link, and no breadcrumb trail appear anywhere in the markup.
findings.fix: Add a second independent wayfinding mechanism, such as a site search input or a link to a site map, that does not merely repeat the links already in #nav.
findings.violation: The page exposes only one mechanism (the primary navigation menu) capable of leading a reader to this page or its siblings, and the page is not marked as one step in a linear process, so it fails the requirement that a reader be able to locate the page through more than one mechanism.
